title: Log in and reach the dashboard
description: A registered user can sign in with valid credentials and land on the protected dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /frontend/login.html
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the authenticated dashboard is displayed

title: Browse the public travel catalogue
description: A visitor can open the public site and see available travel plans listed.

steps.description: Navigate to /frontend/
Verify available travel plans are displayed
Verify the public travel catalogue is visible

Fill in the password fields with a valid matching password

title: Administrator creates a travel plan and sees it listed

Fill in the travel price field with a valid price
Submit the travel creation form
Verify the new travel plan is displayed in the list
